title: Super Sacred Valley of the Incas Full Day Tour
short_description: Enjoy a complete journey through Chinchero, Moray, the Maras Salt Mines, Ollantaytambo and Pisac in a single day.
long_description:
Discover the grandeur of the Sacred Valley of the Incas, one of Cusco's most impressive cultural destinations.

Explore major historic sites surrounded by Andean landscapes and traditional communities: Chinchero, the circular terraces of Moray, the Maras Salt Mines, the fortress of Ollantaytambo and the archaeological complex of Pisac.

days.lugar: Cusco → Chinchero → Moray → Maras → Ollantaytambo → Pisac → Cusco
days.text:
We depart from Cusco toward the Sacred Valley of the Incas.

Our first stop is Chinchero, a traditional Andean town known for its textiles and historic legacy. We continue to Moray to see its circular agricultural terraces and then visit the famous Maras Salt Mines.

After lunch, we explore the archaeological complex of Ollantaytambo. Finally, we visit Pisac, with its Inca terraces and buildings overlooking the valley, before returning to Cusco.
